why_best: This progressive directional unveil reinforces newsroom authority by matching text delivery directly to the rhythm of live speech.
why_bad: A full-block fade or sudden pop-in loses the dynamic cadence of breaking news, making the graphic feel static and disconnected from the voiceover.
trap: A near-miss will feather or blur the leading edge of the transition, rendering the text unfocused rather than razor-sharp as it appears.
